title: Add a "Maximum energy savings" mode/button
line: Choosing Power Save in the Power and Battery widget now also turns off window and desktop animations until you switch back.
explanation: Plasma already has the energy-saving button the wish asks for (Power Save in the Power and Battery widget, and automatically in the low-battery profile), but it only changed power-profiles-daemon's CPU/platform profile: Plasma itself kept spending the same GPU work, rendering every frame of window, overview and desktop animations. KWin now watches power-profiles-daemon's ActiveProfile on the system bus and, while it is power-saver, reports an animation time factor of 0, so all its effects become instant (one frame instead of ~10 per transition). Switching back restores the user's animation speed live; the user's setting itself is never changed.

commits.message:
options: turn off animations while the power-saver profile is active

Picking Power Save in the Power and Battery widget only changed the CPU
and platform profile, while window and desktop animations kept rendering
frames. KWin now makes animations instant while ppd is in power-saver.

BUG: 467253

media.caption: Master, Power Save on: Overview opens and closes with the full animation (about 10 rendered frames per transition).
Patched, Power Save on: Overview opens and closes instantly (one frame per transition).
Master, Power Save on: consecutive frames while Overview closes, the window zooms back over several frames.
Patched, Power Save on: the same frames, Overview is gone after one frame.
Master: Power Save picked in the Power and Battery widget before the recording.
Patched: same Power Save state before the recording.
